description: This file implements a React component 'MessageActions' for managing user interactions with chat messages, including actions like edit, copy, pin, delete, resend, and stop, along with associated utility functions and icon imports.

methods.name: genActionsShema
methods.description: Generates an array of action objects (edit, copy, pin, delete, resend, stop) with their respective icons, titles, classes, and onClick handlers based on the message and provided callback functions.

methods.name: deleteMessage
methods.description: Removes a message from the current session based on its ID.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a message by invoking deleteMessage with the message's ID.

methods.name: onResend
methods.description: Handles resending a message by locating related messages, deleting original ones, and triggering user input for resend.

methods.name: onPinMessage
methods.description: Pins a message to the session context and shows a toast with an optional prompt modal trigger.

methods.name: onUserStop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing response associated with a message via ChatControllerPool.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Allows editing the message content through a prompt, updating the message in the session, and possibly adding media.

methods.name: onCopy
methods.description: Copies the message text content to the clipboard.
